notes.title: Update to Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Ryclaw: Hope has been updated to Version 1.01 today.

Version 1.01

Added background music for the main menu
Added a new track to the beginning of the game
Changed credits to reflect additional track

Thank you to Nomorevideos for suggesting these changes.

Thank you to everyone who has played Ryclaw: Hope during its launch week. We appreciate each and every one of you. We look forward to bringing you more games in the future. You can keep up with upcoming releases and sales on our official twitter page: twitter.com/RyclawGames

notes.title: Ryclaw: Hope nearing release and Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
Ryclaw: Hope is nearing release. While we don't have a firm release date at this time, we are anticipating that we will release in October. We are also pleased to announce that Steam Achievements will be included in the game.

Development of Ryclaw: Hope has been difficult at times. We had to start over with a completely new game engine over halfway into development in order to include the features that are standard for the visual novel genre as well as Steam Achievements. We also changed the vision and visuals of the game, choosing to tell a shorter, more heartfelt story about Sakura, a little girl who refuses to allow her illness to hold her back. Despite our numerous setbacks during development, we are very proud of what Ryclaw: Hope has become and we hope that you will feel the same.

We will announce a release date when the game is completed and cleared by Steam for release. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We will continue to strive to bring you the best game possible.
